units.text: An Act to regulate the abstraction of water and to establish the Water Resources Authority.
“abstraction” means the taking of water from a river, lake or aquifer by any means;
“Authority” means the Water Resources Authority established under section 4.
2. (1) No person shall abstract water without a licence issued by the Authority.
(2) A licence states the quantity of water that may be abstracted each year.
3. A person who abstracts water in breach of section 2 commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one million naira.
4. (1) There is established the Water Resources Authority.
(2) The Authority shall, within three months after the end of each year, submit an annual report of its activities to the Minister.
An Act to conserve fish stocks in inland waters.
1. No person shall fish in inland waters without a fishing permit.
2. The Minister may declare a closed season during which no fishing is permitted in a named lake or river.
3. A person who fishes during a closed season is liable to forfeit the catch and the boat used.
1. An application for a licence to abstract water is made to the Authority on the approved form with the prescribed fee.
2. The Authority shall decide an application within sixty days.
